No FSAD-specific depression or anxiety outcome quantification exists to support any outgoing edge.

Nosology-instability guard recorded: the StatPearls review documents that DSM-5 merged FSAD and hypoactive sexual desire disorder into Female Sexual Interest/Arousal Disorder while the catalog carries the DSM-IV-era FSAD identity, and the batch-26 dyspareunia deferral recorded the adjacent genito-pelvic pain/penetration disorder merger as a directionality barrier for this identity family; authoring mood edges under an unstable identity would risk restatement under a nosology the manual itself declined to draw. Reopening condition: FSAD-stratified cohort evidence of mood outcomes with chronology, plus a qualified-human decision resolving the catalog identity against current DSM-5 naming.
